india_trends.title: After IDBI Bank stake buy, now Fairfax set to sell 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance via ₹3,454-crore block deal: Report
india_trends.summary: Fairfax Financial plans to sell 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance through a block deal, reportedly offering up to 5.65 crore shares at ₹611 each for about ₹3,454 crore. The sale could help fund Fairfax’s proposed $5.56 billion acquisition of a 60% stake in IDBI Bank.

The proceedings began in 2023 over unpaid transportation charges of around ₹71.27 lakh.
